LanguageData.BOR_Slaughter_Desc:
Choose an Umbral and a prisoner. The Umbral pins the prisoner down, carries them to this table and tears them apart alive, limb by limb, leaving blood and feces everywhere. Only the skull remains. It counts as an execution.

For {2}, every Umbral in the colony recovers abilities {0} faster and transforms {1} faster. Can be repeated every {3}.

Disturbing to everyone else, unless their ideoligion exalts it.
LanguageData.BOR_Slaughter_Unreachable: {0} cannot reach the prisoner and the table.
LanguageData.BOR_Slaughter_Done: The Righteous Slaughter is complete. Umbrals blessed: {0}.
